resources.string: ByOS Install %1$s is the latest version.
You have %1$s. Tap to see what is new.
Downloaded and checked. Android asks you to confirm the update.
Allow ByOS Install to Install Updates
Android asks for this once: turn on “Allow from this source”, then come back to this screen.

App updates come from the project\'s releases on GitHub. One is installed only if its description is signed with the project\'s release key and the file matches its size and SHA-256. Android then checks that it comes from the same developer.
The app update was not accepted
The app keeps its current version.
The check for app updates could not be made
Check the internet connection and try again.
GitHub asks to wait before the next check
This update needs a newer version of Android
ByOS Install keeps working with the version you have.
The installer could not be opened
Try again. If it keeps failing, download the app from the project page.
Newer ByOS files come from the project\'s releases on GitHub and are used only if they are signed with the project\'s release key.
Removes this build and anything left from an earlier one. The official firmware v%1$s stays, so it is not downloaded again.
The build was removed. The official firmware is kept.
An earlier build was made from other ByOS files, by another version of the app, or stopped half way. It was removed; build again.
